name: Excalidraw 架构与建模画布
description: 在工作面板里用 Excalidraw 画技术架构图、业务建模图、流程图、时序图：四种图一键生成初稿，再手工拖改；场景可存成 .excalidraw 文件回读，也能导出 SVG 到工作区。

en.name: Excalidraw Studio
en.description: Draw technical architecture, domain-model, flowchart and sequence diagrams on an Excalidraw canvas inside the work panel. Four starters generate a first draft you can drag around; scenes save as .excalidraw files in diagrams/ and export to SVG.
en.safetyNotes: Reads and writes only inside the workspace: reads diagrams/** and *.excalidraw, writes diagrams/**. No network access at runtime (fonts and the Excalidraw bundle ship with the plugin). Your drawings stay on disk in the .excalidraw JSON format, which is plain text.

zh-CN.safetyNotes: 只在工作区内读写：读 diagrams/** 与 *.excalidraw，写 diagrams/**。运行时不联网（字体与 Excalidraw 打包在本插件内）。图保存在 .excalidraw 明文 JSON 里，留在你自己的磁盘上。
